passive_value_contracts.basis: GraphRelation is Copy and contains only MemoryId values, a GraphRelationKind enum, bool, origin enum, and u64 version coordinates. KnowledgeReplacementPlan selects/copies these passive relation facts; no GraphStore, writer, session, callback, or mutation capability crosses the owner boundary.

cut: Gateway invokes operation methods implemented on concrete RelExecutionOwner and PhyExecutionOwner values. Those methods directly operate on owner MemoryStore, GraphStore, CommunityStore, Container and REL Freshness state. Public Cva/Phylactery publication, graph, and community methods delegate to the same lower operation. Memory policy only creates drafts and passive replacement plans over immutable values; it no longer defines an owner-operation callback port.
